guard.note: TIMM 1.1 for NeoForge 1.21: LOGGER.info(debugString) (LOGGER = LogUtils.getLogger(), an slf4j Logger), its only statement: the wrapped call

timm_debug_log_level.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the Logger.info(String) call in Timm.debugLog: the same message to the same logger at DEBUG level. Runtime flag timmDebugLogLevel. Helper bons.furious.patch.timm_c49.TimmLogLevel.
timm_debug_log_level.license: GPL-3.0 (The Immersive Music Mod): no TIMM code is carried, the wrapper only picks the log level

guard.note: registers TIMM's sound events (timm:<event>), whose sounds.json entries name the songs timm:music/<file>, none streamed
the fields from the arguments: location, ..., stream = stream (what shouldStream returns)
shouldStream: returns the stream flag the switch sets for TIMM's songs

play: shouldStream picks the STREAMING channel pool and SoundBufferLibrary.getStream (decoded a second at a time, PlayStreamingSourceEvent) instead of getCompleteBuffer (a cached whole decode, PlaySoundSourceEvent)
getCompleteBuffer: decodes the whole file and keeps the buffer in its cache until clear() (resource reload): the growth the switch avoids

timm_stream_music.conversion: @Inject at the return of Sound's constructor with the stream flag @Shadow @Mutable: set for a sound located in the timm namespace under music/ (TIMM's songs); every other sound keeps the flag its definition gave it, and shouldStream() stays the shipped field read. Runtime flag timmStreamMusic. Helper bons.furious.patch.timm_c49.TimmStreamMusic.
timm_stream_music.license: GPL-3.0 (The Immersive Music Mod) and Minecraft: no code carried

guard.note: HEAD of ServerPlayer.doTick: creative and once-a-second tests, then serverLevel().structureManager() (the inject point) and the structure lookups around the player; a structure leads past the 'not registered' log line only with an entry in StructurePlaylist.DISTANCE_FROM_STRUCTURE
25 StructureManager.getAllStructuresAt lookups (5 x 5 chunks) into a new HashMap
the tag's last path segment: a pure string split
the 'not registered' line: a log call only
getAllStructuresAt: level.getChunk(x, z, STRUCTURE_REFERENCES).getAllReferences(): a chunk lookup (it loads a chunk that is not loaded yet) and a read

timm_structure_scan_idle_skip.conversion: MixinSquared @TargetHandler + cancellable @Inject (priority 1500, require = 0, expect = 0) in TIMM's ServerPlayerMixin.onTick handler, before its ServerLevel.structureManager() call: return while StructurePlaylist.DISTANCE_FROM_STRUCTURE is empty (on 1.21 only TIMM's client setup fills it, so in effect on dedicated servers). Runtime flag timmStructureScanIdleSkip. Helper bons.furious.patch.timm_c49.TimmStructureIdle.
timm_structure_scan_idle_skip.license: GPL-3.0 (The Immersive Music Mod): no TIMM code is carried, the injection only decides whether its unchanged lookups run

guard.note: getSituationalMusic at Musics.CREATIVE: player != null -> getCreativeMusic(player.getRandom()), a non-null song becomes the answer
TIMM's survival answer the switch reuses in creative: biome key of the player's position -> getMusicSound(key, player.getRandom())
biome playlist song, sets CURRENT_BIOME_EVENT (the song, or undefined without one)
creative playlist song; leaves CURRENT_BIOME_EVENT as it was
fade test: the stored biome event of the playing song against the current biome's playlist (no fade for undefined)
startPlaying HEAD: stores CURRENT_BIOME_EVENT for the song that starts

timm_creative_biome_playlist.conversion: MixinSquared @TargetHandler + MixinExtras @WrapOperation (priority 1500, require = 0, expect = 0) on the BiomePlaylist.getCreativeMusic call in TIMM's MinecraftMixin.updateCreativeMusic handler: BiomePlaylist.getMusicSound for the player's biome first, the creative playlist when it has no song. Runtime flag timmCreativeBiomePlaylist. Helper bons.furious.patch.timm_c49.TimmCreativePlaylist.
timm_creative_biome_playlist.license: GPL-3.0 (The Immersive Music Mod): no TIMM code is carried, the wrapper calls TIMM's own playlist methods
